source_contract.toller_2026: Bianchi-Chen-Gamonal, Toller matrices and the Feynman i-epsilon in spinfoams, arXiv:2604.24945 / Phys. Rev. D 114, 046014 (2026): for fixed labels |t^(+/-)| ~ exp[-(1+|k +/- m|) beta] as beta->infinity; gamma-simple spinfoam representations have k=j=l and rho=gamma*j; explicit branch formulas contain inverse powers of sinh(beta) near beta=0.
source_contract.causal_vertex_2026: Bianchi-Chen-Gamonal, Causal spinfoam vertex for 4d Lorentzian quantum gravity, arXiv:2601.23162 / Phys. Rev. D 113, 126020 (2026): the fixed-causal vertex is a product of sign-selected Toller blocks on the Lorentzian 4-simplex graph after gauge fixing.
source_contract.kaminski_2010: Kaminski, arXiv:1010.5384: the 3-edge-connected hyperbolic comparison integral uses exponent 1-tau with tau=1/(2|E1|); for the K5 4-simplex graph |E1|=10 so the comparison exponent is 19/20.
source_contract.scope: Audit only the radial-infinity decay margin and the logically separate local identity-neighborhood obstruction. A good radial tail does not establish full causal-vertex integrability when individual Toller branches are singular as beta->0.

scope_rule: A PASS closes only the radial-infinity subproblem and sharpens the remaining blocker to local identity-neighborhood integrability plus subsequent complete-stack cutoff/normalization and same-realization transport. It must not be promoted to a causal-vertex finiteness theorem, divergence theorem, family FAIL/PASS, NEW_REQUIRED, or D7 authorization.
